lines.text: The Saltreach Isles have always trusted one light.
For a hundred years, the great lighthouse guided every boat safely home.
Three nights ago, the light went dark. Its keeper, Elena Vos, is missing.
Fog is rolling in. The harbor is uneasy, and nobody agrees on what happened.
Tonight, captains gather at the harbor. Meet the others, and help bring the light back.
Welcome to Saltreach Harbor, captain. Look around. You are not alone tonight.
Wave to a captain, win a friendly duel, and open the Keeper's Lock.
Then light the three lamps together.
The old lock answers to the sky, just as the keeper built it.
Gears turn. The door swings open, and warm light spills across the stones.
Inside wait three lamps, cold and quiet. No captain can light them alone.
Three captains. Three lamps. One breath.
The flames catch, and the old tower wakes.
Its beam sweeps across the water. Every boat in the harbor can see the way home.
The light is back. Where it went is still a mystery, if you dare to find out.
